decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans 2011(AR)31-01 Rev A, 2011(AR)31-02 Rev A, 2011(AR)31-03 Rev A, 2011(AR)31-04 Rev A  submitted 03/05/2012  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Retention of the existing single storey outbuilding to the rear of No 146, 148 and 150 for use of the houses and 142 Martindale Road
